ourKits.combo: Vortex Grenade slow → Vaporize pierce → Rocket Dash reposition → Ventilate barrage
ourKits.winCondition: weave abilities for Gunslinger triple-shots and keep Rocket Dash up by hitting heroes
ourKits.passive: casting an ability grants attack speed and makes the next basic fire three times
ourKits.playWith: a frontline that creates space for him to keep shooting
ourKits.playAgainst: Rocket Dash is his only escape and comes back faster when he hits heroes, so engage right after he uses it; Ventilate is a short channel worth interrupting

ourKits.combo: Security Gate roots, Sticky Mine is empowered by a basic attack, Seek and Destroy follows the target, then Tesla Dome traps the fight
ourKits.winCondition: root with the gate and hold enemies inside the Tesla Dome while it shreds magical armor
ourKits.passive: FDA stacks from kills, ability hits and takedowns permanently grant magical power
ourKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies inside the Dome
ourKits.playAgainst: do not walk through Security Gate; leave Tesla Dome early since it grows larger; with no mobility in the kit, dive Gadget after the gate is used; magic armor helps

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link a carry, Psychic Flare around both of you to blind enemies facing it, Energy Lance to stack slows into a root, and Hyperflux to give both of you attack speed, ability haste and speed.
ourKits.winCondition: Power up a linked carry with the Link and Hyperflux and keep them healthy with Essence Catalyst healing.
ourKits.passive: Essence Catalyst: abilities heal her and her linked ally over time, and her Phase Blink has a shorter cooldown and boosts her damage.
ourKits.playWith: The strongest carry to Link, ideally one who wants attack speed and ability haste.
ourKits.playAgainst: Turn away from Psychic Flare, since it only blinds enemies facing it, and break Energy Lance's beam before it reaches the root. Anti-heal cuts the shared healing; focus the linked carry or force the Link out of range.

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap and slow, Unleash for maximum attack speed cleaving basics, Cull to lock the target, Invigorate to cleanse and heal.
ourKits.winCondition: Stick to one target, build Rage for regen and faster cooldowns, and out-sustain them in long fights.
ourKits.passive: Ancestral Fury builds Rage on hits, giving health regen and faster cooldowns, plus movement speed at high Rage.
ourKits.playAgainst: Buy anti-heal to cut Invigorate and Rage regen. Save your CC until after Invigorate is used since it cleanses, and break off for a few seconds so his Rage decays.

ourKits.combo: Skull Crusher leaps in to shred armor and speed him toward the target, Cursed Edge's third slash knocks up and stuns, Dire Howl slows and buffs him, then Kingslayer uppercuts and pummels a hero
ourKits.winCondition: engage, sustain through Dire Howl omnivamp, and out-brawl with Berserk when low
ourKits.passive: below 35% Max Health he goes Berserk with attack speed, movement speed and tenacity, once every 20s
ourKits.playWith: follow-up damage while he commits the dive
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the horizontal third slash of Cursed Edge and sidestep the Kingslayer dash during its slowed charge-up; burst him through Berserk or disengage until it ends; anti-heal cuts Dire Howl healing and armor helps against his physical damage

enemyKits.combo: Void Drone for vision and mana drain, Seismic Assault to knock up and stun, Void Bomb, then Neural Disruptor to silence and finish.
enemyKits.winCondition: Drain mana with Void Drone and land Seismic Assault, then burst with Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage.
enemyKits.passive: Innovation upgrades each ability at max rank and grants ability haste.
enemyKits.playWith: Follow-up damage during Seismic Assault's knockup and stun.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Seismic Assault erupts after a short delay, so sidestep the line. Avoid casting near Void Drone since it zaps and drains mana, and dive her after Seismic Assault is used; magical armor helps.

enemyKits.combo: Reaping Dash in, Hamstring twice to slow, Safeguard to block the key ability, then Earth Shatter to execute and recast on a kill
enemyKits.winCondition: trade with Safeguard up and chain Earth Shatter executes and Reaping Dash cooldown resets in fights
enemyKits.passive: unique hero takedowns permanently grant bonus physical penetration, and all his physical penetration is increased
enemyKits.playWith: setup that holds a target for the Earth Shatter execute
enemyKits.playAgainst: bait Safeguard's Spellshield before committing your key CC; back off when low, since Earth Shatter executes and recasts on a kill; armor counters his physical damage

enemyKits.combo: Riplash to pull a hero in, Shock Therapy to break their shield and silence, Electrocute aura for damage and a shield, then Skewer to suppress everyone in front of him.
enemyKits.winCondition: Land Riplash and chain silence and suppress so the target cannot fight back while their cooldowns stay frozen.
enemyKits.passive: Suspended Sentence: while his abilities immobilize or silence a hero, their cooldowns stop ticking.
enemyKits.playWith: Burst that deletes his pulled or suppressed target.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Stay behind minions or spaced so Riplash cannot reach you, and fight while it is on cooldown. Tenacity shortens the chain, which also shortens the cooldown freeze.

enemyKits.combo: Mercy for 3 Vengeance stacks, Dusk to purify for burst and slow, Shadow Glide to reposition, then Purge while gliding as needed.
enemyKits.winCondition: Stack Vengeance with basics and abilities, then shred the team with Purge and reset Dusk and Shadow Glide on kills.
enemyKits.passive: Nevermore periodically makes her next basic or Mercy fire a Raven that deals current-health damage in a small area.
enemyKits.playWith: Peel that keeps divers off her while she channels Purge.
enemyKits.playAgainst: During Purge she cannot attack or cast anything but Shadow Glide and is slowed, so CC her then. Avoid feeding takedowns since they reset Shadow Glide, and expect Purge's anti-heal.

enemyKits.combo: Evade in → Barricade to block then swing for a stun → Spear of Nyr (bonus damage on low targets) → Coliseum leap to finish
enemyKits.winCondition: leap onto a target with Coliseum for doubled Gladiator power and secure kills to stack permanent power
enemyKits.passive: Gladiator stacks grant physical power and heal him as they fall off after combat
enemyKits.playWith: a team that follows his Coliseum leap onto the target
enemyKits.playAgainst: Barricade only blocks from the front, so hit him from the side or behind and dodge its swing stun; disengage during Coliseum's doubled-power window, and buy armor and anti-heal

loadout.text: Essence Catalyst also restores your Linked Ally's Mana by (+12% Target's Missing Mana) over the duration.

gameFlags.summary: draft broke the fundamentals: 0 tanks, 2 divers vs 1 tank, 2 divers
evidence: Us 0 tanks, 2 divers (48.1% in 1.18 ranked) vs them 1 tank, 2 divers (49.8%).
Out-tanked 0 v 1: teams one tank down won 48% in 1.18. In the game, counting heroes who played as tanks: 1 v 1. Ours: Bayle (2,101 mitigated a minute, 1.6x an average offlaner's).
2 divers (Bayle, Khaimera): each one past the first is a hero not holding the line.
Draft fix: Bayle (offlane) for a real tank: Kaelen 54.6%, Riktor 51.1%, Steel 50.6%.
Zarus 7/3/4, 35% of their kills, 41930 hero damage (the most in the game).
Play against: Barricade only blocks from the front, so hit him from the side or behind and dodge its swing stun; disengage during Coliseum's doubled-power window, and buy armor and anti-heal
Answers: Physical armor on whoever it kept killing. Anti-heal: Tainted Rounds, or Tainted Scepter.

evidence: Bayle died 3 of 7 times to Zarus.
Play against Zarus: Barricade only blocks from the front, so hit him from the side or behind and dodge its swing stun; disengage during Coliseum's doubled-power window, and buy armor and anti-heal

bullets: Ability casts armed Augmentation's empowered next basic attack, on a short cooldown; basic attacks also dealt Mutilator's max-health damage, and Evade's attack speed packed more hits into trades.
Thraex marked Zarus's last basic-attack target for more damage and less taken from that hero; Alpha's Court added damage with no ally near; Rallying Roar shortened Coliseum's cooldown.
Spear of Nyr and Barricade hits applied Tainted Blade's healing cut; later ability hits on that Blighted hero made the hero take more damage for a few seconds.
Void Bomb, Seismic Assault and Void Drone hit areas, so one cast spread Megacosm's damage over time across several heroes, plus Combustion's burst when off cooldown.
Lotus rolled random bonuses like ability haste on a timer and each takedown; Early Bloom granted an extra level; Immaculate cut damage taken near full health.
Takedowns filled Tainted Scepter's Malice stacks at once for extra ability damage on heroes, while Timewarp trimmed basic ability cooldowns every few seconds.
Each ability cast armed Gunslinger's triple-shot attack and, on a short cooldown, Solaris's empowered hit, which healed TwinBlast for part of the damage dealt.
Weald fired true-damage missiles when TwinBlast hit a low-health hero, once per hero per cooldown; Wind-Rider's attack speed after Rocket Dash could add missiles; Forage added farm gold.
Basic attacks on heroes cut Vortex Grenade and Vaporize cooldowns through Ashbringer, once per ability, and shortened Rocket Dash, so casts and dashes came back faster.
Essence Catalyst and Fervour heals gave each healed hero Exarch's attack speed and magic damage on basic attacks; Illumination added health regeneration equal to bonus mana regeneration.
Every cast healed Phase and the Linked Ally through Essence Catalyst, and each heal on an ally gave both Windcaller's short movement burst, once per ally per cooldown.
Hyperflux's ability haste for Phase and the Linked Ally meant more casts and more Essence Catalyst heals; Enra's Blessing shielded immobilized allies nearby, once per ally per cooldown.

coachLean.headline: Gave up the first kill in 7 of 9 fights and lost structures 3 to 7 despite 33,505 objective damage to 14,054.

flags.text: Zarus ran the game at 7/3/4 with 41,930 hero damage, killing Bayle 3 times and Gadget twice.
Lost a fight 0-3 as Mini Prime went to the enemy, and the mid outer tower fell next.
Took Shaper, then lost fights 0-2, 1-2 and 1-4 while the mid inner tower and inhibitor fell.
Won fights 3-0 and 2-0, yet the offlane inner and duo outer towers fell in the same windows.

focus.action: Stop giving up the opening kill: wait out Barricade, Skewer and Seismic Assault, then Khaimera Cull into TwinBlast Ventilate, with Phase Energy Lance guarding TwinBlast.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Carried the damage: 39,408 hero damage, 1,194 a minute and 38% of the team's, with 77% kill participation.
Died first in three lost fights, to Kira, Zarus and Lt. Belica; next game, step in only after Phase or Bayle draws the first CC.
a2a728b5-588e-4433-8c09-a084ccc08d3b: Killed Riktor and Kira on duo-lane rotations, the first followed by Fangtooth, though the duo outer tower fell during the second.
Mid outer, inner and inhibitor each fell right after a death in a lost fight, two to Zarus; next game, stay behind Bayle and outside Zarus's reach.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Held the support job: 77% kill participation, 18 wards against a personal average of 10.6, 15,543 healing and 14,715 mitigated.
River buffs went 9 to 18 against; next game, ward the river ahead of each Fangtooth and Mini Prime spawn.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Led the team with 19,329 objective damage and 12 wards cleared, but hero damage sat at 246 a minute against a personal 366.
Died first in 3 fights, including the 0-3 Mini Prime loss; next game, hold Cull until Barricade, Skewer or Seismic Assault is spent, then catch one target.
85aa99ee-acbb-42a9-ba77-a7b16e32adb1: Took the tank job and the Zarus kills: 2,101 mitigated a minute, 1.6x an average offlaner's, and all 3 Zarus deaths.
Seven deaths, 60% over the personal average, 3 of 7 to Zarus; next game, hit Zarus from the side or behind, since Barricade only blocks from the front.
